fields.description: OpenAI Compatible covers OpenAI itself and any self-hosted vLLM, Ollama, LiteLLM or llama.cpp endpoint speaking the /chat/completions dialect.
fields.label: Provider Type

fields.description: For OpenAI Compatible: the API root ending in /v1 (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1). For Anthropic: leave blank to use https://api.anthropic.com.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Model identifier as the provider expects it (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-4-5, qwen2.5-72b-instruct)
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Optional for keyless self-hosted OpenAI-compatible servers; required for Anthropic.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Seconds to wait for the model before the extraction is marked Failed
fields.label: Request Timeout (Seconds)
Note
fields.options: Document intake sends the full text of supplier documents to the configured endpoint. To keep that data on your own infrastructure, point an OpenAI Compatible provider at a self-hosted model server (vLLM, Ollama, LiteLLM, llama.cpp). No provider is hard-wired and nothing is sent anywhere until an extraction is explicitly triggered.
